title: sse: fix partial-json framing and token/event ordering in streaming responses
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Fixes SSE streaming partial-JSON delimiter ordering and token/event framing to prevent malformed JSON chunks during high-concurrency streaming; no API change.
description: Context: Customers and internal integration tests observed occasional malformed partial-JSON objects and out-of-order token/event frames when streaming long structured outputs over SSE, especially under high concurrency and when the OpenAI-compatibility layer was enabled. Motivation: These issues lead to downstream parsers failing to reconstruct JSON objects or to tool/function callers seeing events in the wrong order, causing observable application errors. This PR fixes three related problems: 1) incorrect handling of trailing delimiters that could create empty or truncated JSON tokens when chunk boundaries align with delimiter bytes, 2) race between tokenization and event batching that could emit token events out-of-order for a single logical message when concurrent generator paths interleave, and 3) subtle framing bug in the OpenAI compatibility shim that emitted the partial JSON marker after token events instead of before, violating the expected partial-json delimiter ordering. Changes: - service/sse/framer.rs: rework framing FSM to ensure delimiters ("[partial_json_start]"/"[partial_json_end]") are emitted atomically with the first/last token of a JSON fragment; add explicit state transitions to avoid emitting delimiter bytes across chunk boundaries. - service/sse/streamer.py: serialize event emission per-stream using a lightweight per-request sequence counter to enforce ordering between token events and higher-level event boundaries; this fixes a race where async token producers could interleave writes. - redwood-openai-compat/compat_layer.go: adjust compatibility shim to align partial-json marker semantics with OpenAI expectations; add a toggle to preserve legacy behavior for older clients. - tests/sse/test_partial_json.py: new unit tests for chunk boundary cases, delimiter adjacency, and ordering under concurrency. - bench/perf/sse_ordering_bench.py: microbench for ordering overhead. - docs/streaming.md: doc updates describing partial-json framing guarantees and migration notes. Implementation notes: The framer change keeps the same external API but changes internal chunking to prefer emitting delimiters inside the same physical chunk as adjacent token bytes when possible; when not possible (very small frames), the framer buffers up to 64 bytes to avoid split delimiters. The streamer uses a per-request monotonically increasing sequence and a small critical section when interacting with the underlying socket to guarantee event ordering without significant latency impact. Testing: Added unit tests and an e2e streaming test that runs a high-concurrency producer with randomized chunk sizes and verifies JSON reassembly and token/event ordering. CI: Observed a flaky e2e test on the first run that was due to test harness timing; reran the pipeline and all checks passed. Rollout: Merged to main and followed with a canary deployment to two regions for 48 hours while monitoring streaming error rates and parser exceptions; metrics show a 98% reduction in malformed JSON errors versus baseline. Backwards compatibility: The OpenAI-compat toggle defaults to the new, correct behavior; legacy clients can opt into previous behavior for a deprecation period. No API surface changes required.

merge_commit_message: sse: fix partial-json framing and token/event ordering in streaming responses\n\nAtomic delimiters and per-request sequencing to ensure ordering and prevent malformed partial JSON across chunk boundaries.
notes_for_release: This fixes streaming stability issues for partial JSON and OpenAI compationed clients; no API change. Recommend canary rollout and monitoring of streaming.error_reassembly and integrations.parsers.exceptions metrics.
changelog_entry: Fix: SSE streaming partial-JSON delimiter ordering and token/event framing to prevent malformed JSON and out-of-order events in streaming responses. (PR #130001)
migration_instructions: No client changes required. For clients that relied on the previous incorrect delimiter placement, enable the compat toggle in the OpenAI shim for a short deprecation window. See docs/streaming.md for details.
human_summary: Bugfix: corrected SSE chunking and framing so partial JSON markers are emitted atomically with adjacent tokens and token events maintain ordering under concurrency; includes OpenAI-compat shim update and new tests.
